stem.text: The melting points of the Period 3 elements phosphorus to argon are shown in the table.
Which factor explains the changes in melting points from phosphorus to argon?

A.text: the changes in electronegativity from phosphorus to argon

B.text: the changes in first ionisation energy from phosphorus to argon

C.text: the increase in the number of electrons in each atom from phosphorus to argon

D.text: the number of atoms in each molecule of the element from phosphorus to argon
